messages:
lee: DAST integration runs failing: uploader reports CMEK decrypt PERMISSION_DENIED when finalizing reports to GCS. Anyone touch CMEK policies recently?
ci-bot: job=ci/dast id=834 failed. snippet:
ERROR: storage: googleapi: Error 403: The caller does not have permission; caused by KMS PERMISSION_DENIED on key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/dast/cryptoKeys/dast-cmek-key
rija: We tightened CMEK bindings last week to only allow cloudrun-instances@redwood-prod. GH Actions runners impersonate gha-actions@redwood-prod. That mismatch could explain it.
maria: Can someone repro with impersonation?
dev: Reprobed: `gcloud kms decrypt --impersonate-service-account=gha-actions@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` -> PERMISSION_DENIED.
oncall: Short fixes: 1) add gha-actions to CryptoKeyDecrypter for the key (scoped); 2) switch bucket to Google-managed CMEK (not ideal); 3) route uploads through a single uploader service with a stable SA. Recommend option 1 to restore CI quickly.
rija: Pushed a scoped binding for gha-actions with a 2-hour TTL to unblock pipelines.
ci-bot: Re-triggered ci/dast id=835 -> succeeded.
lee: Good. Follow-ups: add CMEK preflight to infra PRs that touch key IAM, and enumerate principals that need decrypt rights for each bucket.
maria: Filing SECURITY-802: "CMEK preflight + runner identity audit" w/ tasks: inventory buckets, add impersonation smoke tests, and evaluate uploader proxy pattern.
sec-bot: Added playbook reference: https://wiki.internal/redwood/sec/sdlc/cmek-hardening-playbook and checklist items for postmortem.
rija: I'll schedule TTL expiry and prototype Cloud Run uploader to reduce principal sprawl.
lee: Closing once SECURITY-802 is created and TTL expired.
